slides.title: A faceless AI video pipeline in *7 free steps*
slides.subtitle: Script, voice, B-roll, motion, sound, captions, scheduling

slides.label: 01 · Script
slides.title: Write it with free models
slides.body: Route drafts through FreeLLMAPI or OmniRoute: one endpoint over many free tiers. Prompt: "Write a 70-word voiceover. One idea per line. Every number needs a source link."

slides.label: 02 · Voice
slides.title: Voice it with an open model
slides.body: Kokoro-82M has *Apache-licensed weights*. Hugging Face's new Open TTS Leaderboard puts it among the top three on English intelligibility. Use the Listen tab before you pick.

slides.label: 03 · B-roll
slides.title: Screen-record the real thing
slides.body: Record the actual repo, docs page or changelog you talk about. OBS Studio is free and open source on Windows, Mac and Linux. *Real screens* beat stock typing clips.

slides.label: 04 · Motion
slides.title: Animate text with code
slides.body: Remotion builds videos with React. Free, even commercially, for individuals and companies with up to 3 employees. Bigger teams need a company licence. One idea per screen.

slides.label: 05 · Sound
slides.title: Use sounds you're allowed to use
slides.body: Freesound uses Creative Commons. *CC0* means use freely. Attribution means credit the creator. Noncommercial means no ads. A soft whoosh per scene change is enough.

slides.label: 06 · Captions
slides.title: Caption every word
slides.body: Transcribe your own voiceover so captions match exactly. Hugging Face calls Qwen3 ASR the top open model on its Open ASR Leaderboard. Fix names and numbers *by hand*.

slides.label: 07 · Schedule
slides.title: Schedule, then show up
slides.body: Buffer's free plan connects up to 3 channels with 10 scheduled posts each. Automation can publish. It can't reply to comments *like you do*.
